elements.problem: Page: low risk = not attempted AND no current thoughts/plans AND (no thoughts/plans in past month and no act in past year  OR  history present but not agitated/violent/distressed/uncommunicative). Rule always requires recorded absence of all four agitation findings and never uses absence of the past-month/past-year history, so a patient with no recent history who is agitated or distressed (page: low risk via the past-history "No" branch) is not diagnosed low risk. rule_level_problems.problem: check_for lists 'Planning suicide' both with Current qualifier and unqualified, and does not ask about the attempt itself or 'Thoughts of self harm' within the past month as a distinct item; the check list does not mirror the flowchart's first question.

Urgent trigger includes unqualified 'Thoughts of self harm' (and via descendants any suicidal thought/plan ever recorded), so every patient the page classes low risk is also Urgent; consistent with the box header 'attempted/considered' but means the low/high split does not affect priority. Past-year acts recorded only as history situations do not trigger Urgent.

summary: The low-risk rule is the main defect: it drops the 'no recent history' route to low risk (always requiring no agitation) and depends on recorded absence of attempt events that no check_for asks, so it will rarely or never fire. High-risk logic and the Urgent priority match the flowchart well; the past-year-act criterion is weakened by using onset of history-of situations.
